name: papyrus-scheduled-jobs
description: CDK app for Papyrus scheduled container jobs: a generic EventBridge Scheduler + Step Functions + ECS Fargate construct, the knowledge-run pipeline built on it, and the shared projection lease table.

scripts.diff: ./node_modules/.bin/cdk diff -c site=${SITE:?set SITE=<path-to-site.json>} -c imageTag=${IMAGE_TAG:?set IMAGE_TAG=<ecr image tag>}
scripts.deploy: ./node_modules/.bin/cdk deploy -c site=${SITE:?set SITE=<path-to-site.json>} -c imageTag=${IMAGE_TAG:?set IMAGE_TAG=<ecr image tag>} --require-approval never
